docs.title: 🛒 Grocery Helper
docs.text: A Python library, command-line interface, and Streamlit application that integrates with AnyList to find optimal grocery pricing across stores.

docs.title: What is Grocery Helper?
docs.text:
Most shoppers create a grocery list in AnyList and then wonder:

"Where should I buy these groceries to save the most money, and is it worth visiting multiple stores?"

Grocery Helper answers this question by: 1. Importing your grocery lists from AnyList (or using built-in demo lists). 2. Fetching real-time weekly sales and regional prices across major grocers (ALDI, Market Basket, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Whole Foods, plus nearby stores discovered by ZIP code via Flipp). 3. Listing active weekly on-sale items from local store circulars and matching them against items on your list. 4. Analyzing the trade-offs: - Split Basket: Cheapest overall price by buying each item at its cheapest store. - Single Store: The best single store if you only want to make one stop. - Constrained Stops: Limit your route to at most $N$ stores (e.g. at most 2 stops). 5. Exporting store-specific sub-lists back into AnyList with one click!

docs.title: Quick Example
docs.text:
CLIStreamlit Web UI 
# Optimize a list in offline demo mode
grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo

# Output:
# ======================================================================
# 🛒 Grocery Helper: Weekly Shop (6 items)
# ZIP Code: 90210 | Mode: Demo Mode
# ======================================================================
# Item                     Qty    Best Store       Price      Savings
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Milk                     1 gal  ALDI             $2.85      $1.69
# Sourdough Bread          1 ea   ALDI             $2.20      $0.41
# Free Range Eggs          1 ea   ALDI             $2.68      $1.19
# Honeycrisp Apples        3 lb   ALDI             $1.73      $2.79
# Chicken Breast           2 lb   Kroger           $4.09      $2.30
# Spinach                  1 ea   ALDI             $2.04      $0.36
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optimised Split Basket: $23.14 (Potential Savings: $8.74)
#
# Single-Store Basket Totals:
#   • ALDI          : $23.44 (+$0.30 vs split) ⭐ Best single-trip store
#   • Kroger        : $26.37 (+$3.23 vs split)
#   • Trader Joe's  : $26.68 (+$3.54 vs split)
#   • Whole Foods   : $31.88 (+$8.74 vs split)
# ======================================================================

grocery-helper serve
# Or:
uv run streamlit run src/grocery_helper/app.py

docs.title: 🏗️ Architecture & Design
docs.text: Grocery Helper follows a modular, decoupled architecture centered around Pydantic data models and pluggable providers.

docs.title: grocery_helper.models
docs.text: Defines the core domain entities: - GroceryItem: Product identifier, display name, quantity, measurement unit, category, and checked status. - GroceryList: List container with creation and modification timestamps. - StorePrice: Pricing data per store including regular and promotional sale price, plus optional is_live, matched_product_name, and deal_details metadata for live flyer overlays. - FlyerDeal: Advertised weekly flyer item (store_name, product_name, regular_price, sale_price, prime_price, unit, deal_text, valid_from, valid_to, and effective_sale_price()). - PriceComparison: Cross-store price matrix for a single item, with unit normalization (normalized_price()). - OptimizedCart: The output of basket optimization, including item-to-store mappings, total basket cost, potential savings, and single-store comparison totals.

docs.title: grocery_helper.anylist_client
docs.text: Async HTTP client built around AnyList's /auth/token and protobuf /data/ API: - Generates required X-AnyLeaf-API-Version: 3 and device UUID X-AnyLeaf-Client-Identifier headers. - Handles multipart /auth/token authentication, JWT sub user-ID extraction, automatic /auth/token/refresh retries, protobuf /data/user-data/get decoding, and multipart operations uploads to /data/shopping-lists/update. - Seamless fallback to demo_mode with sample lists ("Weekly Shop", "Party Supplies", "Brunch & Coffee"). - export_split_lists() generates store-specific sub-lists back in AnyList.

docs.title: grocery_helper.flyers
docs.text:
• BaseFlyerProvider: Protocol defining fetch_flyer() and get_prices(item, store_zip).
  • MarketBasketFlyerProvider: Fetches active Market Basket weekly circulars from /wp-json/mb/v1/weekly-flyer and computes sale/regular prices and savings.
  • WholeFoodsFlyerProvider: Extracts store-specific promotions from Whole Foods Market __NEXT_DATA__ SSR HTML (sales-flyer?store-id=...) with support for Amazon Prime pricing and percentage-off promotions.
  • FlippFlyerProvider: Queries Flipp (backflipp.wishabi.com/flipp) by ZIP code to discover local grocery circulars and search advertised items across chains.
  • match_flyer_deals(): Token-similarity matcher linking grocery list entries to active circular titles while avoiding substring false positives (e.g., "milk" vs. "buttermilk").

docs.title: grocery_helper.open_prices
docs.text: • OpenPricesProvider: Queries Open Food Facts' Open Prices REST API (/products + /prices) for receipt- and shelf-tag-verified US retail prices, normalizing store names (Whole Foods Market, Market Basket, Trader Joe's, ALDI, etc.), converting KILOGRAM prices to Unit.LB, and prioritizing local ZIP matches.

docs.title: grocery_helper.pricing
docs.text:
• BasePricingProvider: Protocol specifying async def get_prices(item, store_zip) -> list[StorePrice].
  • MockPricingProvider: Generates deterministic baseline prices with store profiles (ALDI, Market Basket, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Whole Foods).
  • KrogerPricingProvider: Authenticates with Kroger Developer OAuth2, resolves nearest store location by ZIP code, and retrieves live SKU prices.
  • PricingService:
  • Thread-safe TTL caching keyed by provider, flyer settings, Open Prices setting, item name, unit, and ZIP code.
  • Pre-warms and overlays live data with clear precedence: Mock → Open Prices (crowdsourced shelf prices) → Flipp (generic local chains) → Kroger API → store-specific Market Basket & Whole Foods circulars (plus optional flyer_only_for_live_stores=True mode).
  • Computes unconstrained split baskets and evaluates max_stores combinations using subset cover analysis.

docs.title: grocery_helper.matcher
docs.text: Normalizes AnyList user inputs: - Regex-based quantity and unit parser (e.g. "Honeycrisp Apples 3 lbs" $\to$ 3.0, Unit.LB). - Token overlap and sequence matching score calculation.

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text:
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Live Weekly Flyers & Generic Aggregator (grocery_helper.flyers):
  • Added MarketBasketFlyerProvider fetching weekly circular JSON from shopmarketbasket.com/wp-json/mb/v1/weekly-flyer with multi-buy, per-lb, and savings parsing.
  • Added WholeFoodsFlyerProvider extracting store-specific weekly sales and Prime member pricing from wholefoodsmarket.com/sales-flyer?store-id=<id>.
  • Added FlippFlyerProvider (backflipp.wishabi.com/flipp) for generic ZIP-code circular discovery and cross-store sale item search (e.g. ALDI, Star Market, Shaw's, Stop & Shop, Hannaford, Wegmans, Big Y, Costco, Target, Walmart).
  • Added FlyerDeal model and extended StorePrice with is_live, matched_product_name, and deal_details.
  • Open Prices Crowdsourced Retail Pricing (grocery_helper.open_prices):
  • Added OpenPricesProvider querying Open Food Facts' Open Prices REST API (prices.openfoodfacts.org/api/v1) with product-code search, category-tag staple fallback, ZIP proximity ranking, per-kilogram unit conversion, and cache isolation.
  • Wired enable_open_prices (Mock → Open Prices → Flipp → Kroger → Market Basket & Whole Foods direct flyers precedence) into PricingService, .env config (ENABLE_OPEN_PRICES, OPEN_PRICES_BASE_URL), Streamlit sidebar (Include Open Prices (Crowdsourced)), and CLI (--open-prices / --no-open-prices).
  • Single-Store Savings Comparison (grocery_helper.models, grocery_helper.pricing, grocery_helper.app, grocery_helper.cli):
  • Added OptimizedCart.savings_vs_best_single_store and savings_pct_vs_best_single_store, plus build_stop_count_summary() to compare total cost and savings for 1..N store stops against the generally cheapest single store in both Streamlit and the CLI.
  • Add Weekly On-Sale Items to List (grocery_helper.app):
  • Added deal_to_grocery_item() and interactive row-selection + multiselect controls in the 🏷️ Weekly Sales & Flyers tab so users can add any weekly on-sale item directly to their active AnyList grocery list with quantity, unit, category, store, price, and clean promotional notes.
  • Persistent UI Settings & Default Store Configuration (grocery_helper.preferences, grocery_helper.config, grocery_helper.app):
  • Added DEFAULT_ALLOWED_STORES, DEFAULT_MAX_STORES, ADVERTISED_ONLY, and UI_SETTINGS_FILE configuration settings.
  • Added ~/.config/grocery_helper/ui_settings.json persistence to save non-secret sidebar selections (ZIP code, stores, max stops, flyer/Open Prices toggles, Whole Foods store ID, and selected list ID) across runs with a one-click Reset Saved Settings control.
  • AnyList Store Management & List Sync (grocery_helper.anylist_client, grocery_helper.app):
  • Added AnyListClient.ensure_store() to look up or create store records (new-store via /data/shopping-lists/update-v2) and AnyListClient.sync_cart_to_list() to push optimized store, price, category, and quantity subfields back onto an existing list.
  • Added the 🔄 Update '' in AnyList action alongside store sub-list export on the Optimised Cart tab.
  • Pricing, UI & CLI Support (grocery_helper.pricing, grocery_helper.app, grocery_helper.cli):
  • Added "Market Basket" to MockPricingProvider.STORE_PROFILES.
  • Updated PricingService to pre-warm and overlay Flipp, Market Basket, and Whole Foods live flyers (with enable_live_flyers, enable_flipp, flyer_only_for_live_stores, whole_foods_store_id, whole_foods_prime, and flipp_merchants).
  • Added the grocery-helper flyers CLI subcommand and --live-flyers, --advertised-only, --wf-store-id, --no-prime, --no-flipp, and --flipp-merchants flags to optimise.

docs.title: Improved
docs.text:
• Unit-Aware Price Comparison (grocery_helper.models, grocery_helper.pricing):
  • Added convert_unit_price(), PriceComparison.normalized_price(), and PriceComparison.has_unit_mismatch to normalize comparable volume (gallon ↔ liter) and weight (lb ↔ oz) prices.
  • Improved catalog matching for pack-suffixed items (e.g. Soda 12pk) and descriptive names via containment-weighted token scoring in matcher.py.
  • Streamlit Navigation (grocery_helper.app):
  • Ordered primary result tabs so 🛒 Optimised Cart appears first, followed by 📊 Price Comparison and 🏷️ Weekly Sales & Flyers.
  • Performance, Tooling & CI/CD:
  • Parallelized item price fetches via asyncio.gather and added shared httpx.AsyncClient connection pooling for KrogerPricingProvider during PricingService.optimise().
  • Cached live AnyList list fetches in Streamlit session_state with a manual refresh button and extracted pure view-model helpers (build_comparison_rows, group_cart_by_store).
  • Consolidated duplicate dev dependency definitions in pyproject.toml, expanded .github/workflows/ci.yml to run formatting, lint, mypy, pytest coverage, and strict MkDocs builds across Python 3.11/3.12 on all pushes/PRs/manual triggers, and optimized .github/workflows/docs.yml with concurrency and --no-install-project --only-group docs.

docs.title: Fixed
docs.text:
• Live AnyList Authentication & Full Protobuf Subfield Sync (grocery_helper.anylist_client, grocery_helper.models, grocery_helper.app):
  • Replaced the legacy /data/users/login placeholder (which returned HTTP 403 and was misreported as an invalid password) with AnyList's real multipart POST /auth/token login and /auth/token/refresh token-renewal flow, plus multipart form uploads without filename so operations are processed properly.
  • Added pure-Python Protocol Buffer serialization/deserialization for POST /data/user-data/get (PBUserDataResponse, including list stores and category groups) and multipart operations uploads (PBListOperationList).
  • Extended GroceryItem (store, price, price_details) and protobuf encoding (PBListItem) to populate AnyList native category (category, categoryMatchId, and PBListItemCategoryAssignment with normalize_category_name()), quantity (quantityPb.rawQuantity + deprecatedQuantity), price (PBItemPrice), and store (storeIds), using update-list-item while preserving unmanaged fields and keeping promotional notes clean (_clean_promo_note()).
  • Enriched exported items in export_split_lists() with assigned stores, normalized prices, and canonical categories.
  • Unified network/auth error handling (httpx.RequestError and 401/403) across add_item, remove_item, update_item, and create_list, preserved 0 item quantities and units on decode, and cleared _http on __aexit__.
  • Streamlit UI, Route Consistency & Reload Safety (grocery_helper.models, grocery_helper.app, grocery_helper.cli):
  • Added _ReloadSafeModel coercion across core Pydantic models and JSON serialization for Streamlit session_state caches so hot module reloads never trigger ValidationError when filtering stores or recalculating baskets.
  • Updated Streamlit st.dataframe / st.bar_chart calls from deprecated use_container_width=True to width="stretch".
  • Fixed StreamlitAPIException crash when selecting 0 or 1 allowed stores in the sidebar (max_stores slider bounds).
  • Updated Shopping Route UI and CLI text table to render assigned stores and prices from cart.store_assignments instead of unconstrained comp.cheapest, using Decimal arithmetic for subtotals.
  • Persisted demo-mode AnyList state and stable list-ID selection across Streamlit reruns so added items and exported sub-lists are retained.
  • Replaced unsafe run_async fallback so coroutine RuntimeErrors are not masked and active event loops are handled cleanly.
  • Added unified error handling around item creation, list updates, and split-list exports.
  • Pricing Optimizer, Cache & Matcher Safety (grocery_helper.pricing, grocery_helper.utils, grocery_helper.matcher):
  • Calculated estimated_savings relative to each item's assigned store price under max_stores constraints.
  • Enforced max_stores even when items lack prices or subsets provide partial coverage; validated max_stores >= 1.
  • Isolated in-memory price cache keys by unit and provider configuration, added threading.RLock synchronization, and exposed clear_price_cache().
  • Guarded KrogerPricingProvider against missing tokens/locations and added token expiry tracking and 401 refresh retries.
  • Fixed truncate(..., max_len=0) edge case and prevented punctuation-only strings or hyphenated prefixes (e.g. L-Carnitine) from false-matching in matcher.py.
Initial release of Grocery Helper — a Python library, CLI, and Streamlit application that connects to AnyList, compares grocery prices across stores, and computes optimal shopping routes.

docs.title: Core & Architecture
docs.text:
• Data Models (grocery_helper.models):
  • GroceryItem: ID, name, quantity, unit, category, notes, and checked status.
  • GroceryList: Container with timestamps and list metadata.
  • StorePrice: Price per unit, sale price, store identifiers, and effective price computation.
  • PriceComparison: Multi-store item comparison, identifying cheapest grocer and potential savings.
  • OptimizedCart: Multi-store split assignments, total basket cost, estimated savings, single-store comparison totals, and route constraint metadata.
  • Centralized Configuration (grocery_helper.config):
  • Pydantic Settings integration reading environment variables and .env files.
  • Settings for AnyList credentials, Kroger Developer API credentials, cache TTL, and default ZIP code.
  • Shared Utilities (grocery_helper.utils):
  • Normalized in-memory TTL caching (TTLCache) for price queries.
  • Currency and savings string formatters (format_currency, format_savings).
  • @timed execution profiling decorator for sync and async functions.

docs.title: AnyList Integration (grocery_helper.anylist_client)
docs.text:
• Async HTTP client with internal AnyList API endpoints (/data/users/login, /data/shopping-lists/get, /data/shopping-lists/add-item, etc.).
  • Mobile client header support (X-AnyLeaf-API-Version: 3, X-AnyLeaf-Client-Identifier, custom User-Agent).
  • Offline Demo Mode:
  • Provides pre-populated sample lists ("Weekly Shop", "Party Supplies", "Brunch & Coffee").
  • Enables zero-configuration testing and local UI preview without active AnyList credentials.
  • Sub-List Export:
  • export_split_lists() method to generate store-specific shopping lists (e.g. "Weekly Shop (ALDI)", "Weekly Shop (Kroger)") directly in AnyList.

docs.title: Pricing & Basket Optimization (grocery_helper.pricing)
docs.text:
• Pluggable Provider Protocol (BasePricingProvider):
  • Standardized interface for querying grocery item pricing by location.
  • Mock Pricing Provider (MockPricingProvider):
  • Generates realistic, deterministic pricing profiles for ALDI, Trader Joe's, Kroger, and Whole Foods.
  • Handles regular price variations and occasional promotional sale discounts.
  • Live Kroger Developer API Provider (KrogerPricingProvider):
  • OAuth2 client credentials authentication against api.kroger.com.
  • Automatic nearest store location discovery using ZIP code.
  • Live product search and real-time regular and promotional price extraction.
  • Optimization Algorithms:
  • Unconstrained multi-store split optimization for maximum savings.
  • Constrained Route Optimization:
    • allowed_stores: Restrict shopping exclusively to selected stores.
    • max_stores: Limit stops to at most $N$ stores (e.g. max_stores=1 for single-trip shopping, max_stores=2 for two-store split).
  • Single-store basket totals comparison to weigh travel inconvenience against multi-store savings.

docs.title: Item Normalization & Matching (grocery_helper.matcher)
docs.text:
• Regex-based embedded quantity and unit extractor (e.g. "Honeycrisp Apples 3 lbs" $\to$ 3.0, LB).
  • Text normalizer stripping punctuation, abbreviations, and case variations.
  • Token-overlap and sequence-matching similarity scoring to match user item names to store SKUs.

docs.title: User Interfaces
docs.text:
• Streamlit Web Application (grocery_helper.app):
  • Interactive sidebar with credential configuration, ZIP code lookup, and demo mode toggle.
  • Optimization controls: Allowed stores multiselect and max stores trip limit slider.
  • In-app "➕ Add Item" form to append items to lists directly in the web UI.
  • Comprehensive price comparison data table with sale indicators and best store badges.
  • Metrics cards (Optimized Total, Estimated Savings, Best Single Store recommendation).
  • Total basket cost comparison bar chart (st.bar_chart).
  • Expandable shopping route per store with subtotal breakdowns.
  • One-click "📤 Export Store Lists to AnyList" button.
  • CLI Interface (grocery_helper.cli):
  • grocery-helper serve: Launches Streamlit application with configurable --port and --host.
  • grocery-helper optimise <list_id>: Headless CLI optimization with --demo, --zip, --max-stores, --stores, and --json export flags.

docs.title: CI/CD & Testing
docs.text:
• GitHub Actions CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) testing formatting, linting, type-checking, and coverage on push and pull requests.
  • Test suite with 100 tests spanning unit tests, model tests, mock HTTP transport tests, and Streamlit AppTest UI flow tests.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text:
• Non-Developer Shopper's Guide: Comprehensive, step-by-step user guide explaining the app workflow, store selection, "max stores" trip slider, AnyList sub-list export, and item naming tips for everyday shoppers.
  • GitHub Pages Documentation Site: MkDocs Material site deployed automatically via GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/docs.yml) covering architecture, Streamlit UI, CLI reference, configuration, and developer setup.

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Reference
docs.text: Grocery Helper manages its configuration using pydantic-settings, reading from environment variables and .env files.

docs.title: Environment Variables
docs.text: Variable Type Default Description ANYLIST_EMAIL String "" AnyList account login email. ANYLIST_PASSWORD String "" AnyList account login password. ANYLIST_API_BASE_URL String https://www.anylist.com Base URL for AnyList internal API routes. DEFAULT_STORE_ZIP String "" Default ZIP code for grocery store lookups. PRICE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS Integer 3600 In-memory price result caching duration in seconds. KROGER_CLIENT_ID String "" OAuth2 Client ID from Kroger Developer Portal. KROGER_CLIENT_SECRET String "" OAuth2 Client Secret from Kroger Developer Portal. KROGER_API_BASE_URL String https://api.kroger.com/v1 Base URL for Kroger Developer API. ENABLE_LIVE_FLYERS Boolean false Fetch live weekly flyer sale items during pricing and optimization. ENABLE_FLIPP Boolean true Include generic nearby store flyers via Flipp when ENABLE_LIVE_FLYERS=true. ENABLE_OPEN_PRICES Boolean false Overlay crowdsourced retail receipt/shelf prices from Open Prices. OPEN_PRICES_BASE_URL String https://prices.openfoodfacts.org/api/v1 Base URL for Open Food Facts Open Prices REST API. WHOLE_FOODS_STORE_ID String "10010" Whole Foods store ID for local weekly sales flyer (e.g. 10010 Cambridge). WHOLE_FOODS_PRIME Boolean true Prefer Amazon Prime member sale prices for Whole Foods deals. MARKET_BASKET_FLYER_URL String https://www.shopmarketbasket.com/wp-json/mb/v1/weekly-flyer JSON endpoint for Market Basket weekly flyer items. WHOLE_FOODS_BASE_URL String https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com Base URL for Whole Foods Market sales flyers. FLIPP_BASE_URL String https://backflipp.wishabi.com/flipp Base URL for Flipp circular discovery and item search. APP_TITLE String Grocery Helper Title displayed in Streamlit browser tabs. DEBUG Boolean false Enable verbose debug logging output.

docs.title: Live Weekly Flyers Setup (Optional)
docs.text:
Grocery Helper can fetch live weekly advertised sale prices from three sources without requiring API keys:

  1. Market Basket (shopmarketbasket.com/wp-json/mb/v1/weekly-flyer): Automatically fetches active weekly circular deals across all Market Basket stores.
  2. Whole Foods Market (wholefoodsmarket.com/sales-flyer?store-id=...): Fetches store-specific weekly promotions and Amazon Prime member pricing. Set WHOLE_FOODS_STORE_ID to your preferred store (for example: 10010 Cambridge, 10380 Medford, 10090 Bedford, 10156 Framingham, 10371 Andover).
  3. Flipp (backflipp.wishabi.com/flipp): Automatically discovers nearby grocery store circulars for your DEFAULT_STORE_ZIP (such as ALDI, Star Market, Shaw's, Stop & Shop, Hannaford, Wegmans, Big Y, Costco, Target, and Walmart).

To enable live flyer overlays by default in both the CLI and Streamlit UI, add the following to .env:

DEFAULT_STORE_ZIP=02139
WHOLE_FOODS_STORE_ID=10010
WHOLE_FOODS_PRIME=true
ENABLE_LIVE_FLYERS=true
ENABLE_FLIPP=true

docs.title: Kroger Developer API Setup (Optional)
docs.text:
To enable live grocery prices from Kroger: 1. Register for a free developer account at developer.kroger.com. 2. Create a new App in your Kroger developer dashboard. 3. Copy your Client ID and Client Secret. 4. Add them to your .env file: 

KROGER_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id_here
KROGER_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret_here
5. When running optimizations, live Kroger SKU prices will automatically overlay onto your results!

docs.title: Local Setup
docs.text:
Ensure you have uv installed.

# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/cuyler/grocery_helper.git
cd grocery_helper

# Install all runtime, dev, and documentation dependencies
uv sync --all-groups

docs.title: 1. Test Suite & Coverage
docs.text: uv run pytest

docs.title: 2. Code Formatting & Linting
docs.text:
# Check formatting
uv run ruff format --check .

# Automatically format code
uv run ruff format .

# Run linter
uv run ruff check .

docs.title: 3. Static Type Checking
docs.text: uv run mypy src/ tests/

docs.title: Building the Documentation Locally
docs.text:
To preview the documentation site locally with hot-reloading:

uv run mkdocs serve

Then visit http://127.0.0.1:8000 in your browser.

To build the static HTML site for publishing:

uv run mkdocs build
The compiled static assets will be located in the site/ directory.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• uv (Fast Python package and environment manager)
  • Python 3.11+

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Clone the repository and install dependencies with uv:

git clone https://github.com/cuyler/grocery_helper.git
cd grocery_helper

# Install dependencies into virtualenv managed by uv
uv sync

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Copy the example environment template:

cp .env.example .env

Open .env in your editor:

# ── AnyList credentials (Optional for Demo Mode) ───────────────────────────
ANYLIST_EMAIL=you@example.com
ANYLIST_PASSWORD=your_password

# ── Store settings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DEFAULT_STORE_ZIP=90210

# ── Cache ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PRICE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=3600

# ── Kroger Developer API (Optional live data) ─────────────────────────────────
KROGER_CLIENT_ID=
KROGER_CLIENT_SECRET=

# ── Weekly Flyer Sources (Market Basket, Whole Foods & Flipp) ───────────────
WHOLE_FOODS_STORE_ID=10010
WHOLE_FOODS_PRIME=true
ENABLE_LIVE_FLYERS=false
ENABLE_FLIPP=true

Demo Mode Works Out of the Box

If you don't provide AnyList credentials or Kroger API keys, Grocery Helper automatically runs in Demo Mode. You can immediately explore sample grocery lists and mock pricing without creating any accounts.

docs.title: 1. Interactive Streamlit Web UI
docs.text:
Run the programmatic serve command:

uv run grocery-helper serve

Or via Streamlit directly:

uv run streamlit run src/grocery_helper/app.py

Then open http://localhost:8501 in your browser.

docs.title: 2. Command-Line Interface (CLI)
docs.text:
To optimize a list directly in the terminal:

uv run grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo

To list live weekly on-sale items from Market Basket, Whole Foods, and nearby stores in your ZIP code:

uv run grocery-helper flyers --demo --list-id list_001 --zip 02139

docs.title: ⌨️ Command-Line Interface (CLI) Reference
docs.text: The grocery-helper CLI allows automated, headless execution for shell scripts, scheduled tasks, and CI/CD pipelines.

docs.title: Subcommands Overview
docs.text: grocery-helper [-h] {serve,optimise,flyers} ...

docs.title: grocery-helper serve
docs.text:
Launch the Streamlit web application.

grocery-helper serve [--port PORT] [--host HOST]

docs.title: Options:
docs.text:
• --port PORT: Port to bind Streamlit server to (default: 8501).
  • --host HOST: Address to listen on (default: localhost).

docs.title: Example:
docs.text: grocery-helper serve --port 8080 --host 0.0.0.0

docs.title: grocery-helper optimise
docs.text:
Run the pricing optimizer for a grocery list.

grocery-helper optimise <list_id> [OPTIONS]

docs.title: Positional Arguments:
docs.text: • list_id: Identifier of the list to optimize (e.g. list_001).

docs.title: Options:
docs.text:
• --demo: Run in offline demo mode using built-in sample lists.
  • --zip ZIP: Specify store ZIP code for local pricing (default: from .env or 90210).
  • --max-stores N: Limit the shopping route to at most $N$ stores (e.g. 1 or 2).
  • --stores [STORES ...]: Space-separated list of store names to consider.
  • --live-flyers: Overlay live weekly advertised sale prices from Market Basket, Whole Foods, and Flipp.
  • --advertised-only: For Market Basket and Whole Foods, use only advertised weekly flyer items instead of baseline estimates.
  • --wf-store-id ID: Whole Foods store ID for weekly sales flyer lookup (default: 10010).
  • --no-prime: Use regular Whole Foods sale prices instead of Prime member prices.
  • --no-flipp: Disable generic nearby store circular lookups via Flipp when --live-flyers is set.
  • --flipp-merchants [STORES ...]: Restrict Flipp lookup to specific store names (e.g. Hannaford "Star Market" ALDI).
  • --open-prices / --no-open-prices: Enable or disable crowdsourced Open Prices shelf-price lookups (prices.openfoodfacts.org).
  • --json: Output raw JSON data instead of formatted terminal text.

docs.title: grocery-helper flyers
docs.text:
List active weekly advertised on-sale items from Market Basket, Whole Foods, and nearby stores via Flipp.

grocery-helper flyers [OPTIONS]

docs.title: Options:
docs.text:
• --store {all,mb,wf,flipp}: Flyer source(s) to fetch (all by default; mb Market Basket; wf Whole Foods; flipp all nearby stores by ZIP).
  • --zip ZIP: ZIP/postal code for Flipp circular discovery (default: from .env or 02139).
  • --merchants [STORES ...]: Optional Flipp merchant allow-list (e.g. "Star Market" Hannaford ALDI).
  • --wf-store-id ID: Whole Foods store ID (default: 10010).
  • --no-prime: Show regular Whole Foods sale prices instead of Prime member prices.
  • --search KEYWORD: Filter on-sale items by keyword (product name, brand, description, or department).
  • --list-id LIST_ID: Highlight weekly flyer deals matching items on an AnyList shopping list.
  • --demo: Load --list-id from built-in sample lists.
  • --json: Output raw JSON instead of a formatted table.

docs.title: Basic Optimization in Demo Mode
docs.text: grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo

docs.title: Restrict to at most 2 Stores
docs.text: grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo --max-stores 2

docs.title: Compare Only ALDI and Trader Joe's
docs.text: grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo --stores ALDI "Trader Joe's"

docs.title: Optimize with Live Weekly Flyers (Market Basket, Whole Foods & Flipp)
docs.text: grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo --live-flyers --zip 02139 --wf-store-id 10010

docs.title: List All Weekly On-Sale Items & Match Your List
docs.text:
# Market Basket + Whole Foods + nearby Flipp stores matched against demo list_001
grocery-helper flyers --demo --list-id list_001 --zip 02139

# Search Flipp deals at specific local chains
grocery-helper flyers --store flipp --zip 02139 --merchants Hannaford "Star Market" ALDI --search chicken

docs.title: Output JSON for Automation Scripts
docs.text:
grocery-helper optimise list_001 --demo --json

docs.title: 🖥️ Streamlit Web App Guide
docs.text: The Streamlit interface provides an interactive, visual dashboard for managing grocery lists and analyzing multi-store shopping routes.

docs.title: Launching the Web App
docs.text: uv run grocery-helper serve

docs.title: 1. Settings & Sidebar
docs.text:
• Credentials: Enter your AnyList email and password to sync your live account.
  • Store ZIP Code: Set your local ZIP code (e.g. 02139) to discover nearby store circulars and grocers.
  • Demo Mode Toggle: When enabled, the app uses built-in sample lists and baseline pricing.
  • Store Filters (Allowed Stores): Multiselect grocers to include or exclude (ALDI, Market Basket, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Whole Foods).
  • Max Stores Slider: Limit your route to at most $N$ stops (e.g. max_stores=1 for single-trip shopping).
  • Weekly Flyers (MB, Whole Foods & Flipp):
  • Enable Live Weekly Flyers: Overlay live weekly sale prices from Market Basket, Whole Foods, and nearby Flipp stores onto comparisons.
  • Include Nearby Flipp Stores (by ZIP): Discover and compare circulars across nearby grocers (e.g. Star Market, Shaw's, Stop & Shop, Hannaford, Wegmans, Big Y, ALDI, Costco) by ZIP code.
  • Advertised flyer prices only (MB & Whole Foods): Omit baseline estimates for items not in the Market Basket or Whole Foods weekly flyers.
  • Whole Foods Store ID: Set your local Whole Foods store ID (e.g. 10010 Cambridge, 10380 Medford, 10156 Framingham).
  • Whole Foods Prime Pricing: Apply Amazon Prime member discounts when listed in the Whole Foods flyer.
  • Include Open Prices (Crowdsourced): Overlay receipt- and shelf-tag-verified prices from Open Food Facts' Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org) when items are not in weekly flyers.
  • Saved Preferences Between Runs: Non-secret sidebar choices (allowed stores, max stores, ZIP code, flyer/Open Prices toggles, Whole Foods store ID, and your last selected list) are automatically saved to ~/.config/grocery_helper/ui_settings.json and restored on restart. Click Reset Saved Settings at the bottom of the sidebar to clear them back to .env defaults (credentials are never saved to this file). You can also set DEFAULT_ALLOWED_STORES (comma-separated store names) and DEFAULT_MAX_STORES directly in .env.

docs.title: 2. In-App Item Management
docs.text: Above the results tabs, expand "➕ Add an Item to this List": - Enter an item name (e.g. "Greek Yogurt" or "Avocados"). - Specify quantity and unit (each, lb, oz, gallon, pack, liter). - Click "Add to List" to immediately update the list and re-calculate optimal pricing!

docs.title: 3. Optimised Cart Tab
docs.text:
• Metric Cards:
  • Optimised Basket Total: Total cost when buying each item at its cheapest store.
  • Estimated Total Savings: Dollar amount saved across the basket.
  • Best Single Store: The cheapest single store if you only make one stop, along with the cost delta.
  • Cost Comparison Bar Chart: Visual comparison of the optimized split vs. shopping exclusively at a single store.
  • Store Route Expanders: Itemized shopping lists grouped by store with subtotals.
  • Update List or Export Store Sub-Lists to AnyList: Use 🔄 Update '' in AnyList to push assigned stores, prices, categories, and quantities directly onto items in your active list, or 📤 Export Store Lists to AnyList to create store-specific sub-lists (e.g. "Weekly Shop (ALDI)").

docs.title: 4. Price Comparison Tab
docs.text: A comprehensive data table detailing: - Every grocery item on your list and its quantity. - Prices across all considered stores (highlighting promotional sales and live weekly flyer deals with 🏷️). - The identified cheapest store and best unit price. - Potential savings compared to the highest-priced store.

docs.title: 5. 🏷️ Weekly Sales & Flyers Tab
docs.text: Browse and search active weekly sale items directly in the app: - Click "🔄 Load / Refresh Live Weekly Flyers" (or enable Live Weekly Flyers in the sidebar) to fetch circulars from Market Basket, Whole Foods, and nearby Flipp stores. - 🎯 On-Sale Matches for Your Current List: Automatically highlights items from your active grocery list that are currently on sale, showing matched flyer titles, sale prices, regular prices, and deal terms. - 📋 Browse All Weekly On-Sale Items: Filter active weekly deals by store, search by keyword, toggle Featured Only, check rows directly in the table or select deals in the Or pick weekly sale item(s) to add picker, and add them straight onto your active AnyList shopping list.

docs.title: 🛍️ Shopper's Guide (Non-Developer)
docs.text: Welcome to Grocery Helper! This guide is written for everyday shoppers who want to save money on groceries without spending hours comparing store circulars or flipping between different shopping apps.

docs.title: 🎯 What Does Grocery Helper Do?
docs.text:
Grocery prices vary wildly between stores. Milk might be \$1.80 cheaper at ALDI, while fresh sourdough is cheaper at Trader Joe's, and your favorite coffee is on sale at Kroger.

Grocery Helper: 1. Connects to your AnyList grocery list (on your phone or computer). 2. Checks prices and live weekly sales flyers across nearby stores (ALDI, Market Basket, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Whole Foods, plus other local grocers in your ZIP code via Flipp). 3. Shows which items on your list are currently on sale and lets you browse weekly circulars in one place. 4. Tells you the cheapest single store to visit if you're in a hurry, or how much more you save by splitting your trip across 2 or more stores. 5. Automatically creates store-specific shopping lists back on your phone so you can easily check items off while shopping!

flowchart LR
    A["📱 Your AnyList<br/>('Weekly Groceries')"] --> B["🛒 Grocery Helper<br/>(Price Comparison Engine)"]
    B --> C["🏪 Store A List<br/>('ALDI - Produce & Dairy')"]
    B --> D["🏪 Store B List<br/>('Trader Joe's - Snacks')"]

docs.title: 🚀 How to Start the App
docs.text:
You don't need to know how to code to run Grocery Helper.

  1. Open your computer's Terminal (Mac) or Command Prompt / PowerShell (Windows).
  2. Type or paste this command and press Enter: 
    grocery-helper serve
  3. Your web browser will automatically open with the Grocery Helper dashboard (at http://localhost:8501).

Closing the App

When you are done, simply close your browser window. In your terminal, you can press Ctrl + C to stop the app.

docs.title: 🧭 Step-by-Step Walkthrough
docs.text: When the web app opens, you'll see a clean shopping dashboard with a sidebar on the left and your shopping lists on the right.

docs.title: Step 1: Choose Demo Mode or Connect Your AnyList Account
docs.text:
• Just Want to Try It Out? Keep Demo Mode checked in the left sidebar! The app comes preloaded with sample lists ("Weekly Shop", "Party Supplies", and "Brunch & Coffee") so you can test all features without entering any credentials.
  • Ready to Use Your Own Lists? In the left sidebar, uncheck Demo Mode and enter your AnyList Email and Password. Your lists will automatically appear in the dropdown menu.

[!NOTE] Your AnyList password is stored only on your computer in your local configuration and is never sent to third-party tracking servers.

docs.title: Step 2: Choose Your Local Stores
docs.text:
Not everyone has every grocery store nearby. In the sidebar under "Allowed Stores": - Check the stores you are willing to shop at (e.g., ALDI, Trader Joe's, Kroger). - Uncheck any stores that aren't near you or that you don't prefer.

You can also enter your ZIP Code to discover nearby store flyers (such as Star Market, Shaw's, Stop & Shop, Hannaford, and Wegmans) and toggle Enable Live Weekly Flyers to overlay current weekly sales from Market Basket, Whole Foods (with optional Prime Pricing), and Flipp directly onto your comparisons.

docs.title: Browse All Weekly On-Sale Items
docs.text: Switch to the 🏷️ Weekly Sales & Flyers tab at any time to: - See which items on your current grocery list are on sale this week. - Search and filter full weekly circulars across Market Basket, Whole Foods, and nearby Flipp stores. - Check table rows or pick sale items from the dropdown to add weekly deals directly onto your active AnyList grocery list.

docs.title: Step 3: Choose Your Trip Style ("Max Stores" Slider)
docs.text:
How much time do you have to shop this week? Use the "Max Store Stops" slider to set your preference:

Slider Setting What It Means Best For 1 Store Finds the single cheapest store for your entire basket. Zero extra driving. Busy weekdays or quick errands. 2 Stores Splits your basket across the top 2 stores to unlock major savings while keeping driving manageable. The sweet spot for weekly shopping! 3+ Stores Finds the absolute rock-bottom price across every store. Maximum possible budget savings.

docs.title: Step 4: Review Your Savings & Price Comparisons
docs.text: Click the Price Comparison tab to see a breakdown of your list: - Each item is shown alongside its price at every selected store. - Green badges highlight promotional sales and discounts. - The Cheapest Store column shows you exactly where to buy each item. - The Savings column shows how much you save on each product compared to the highest-priced store.

docs.title: Step 5: Add Extra or Forgotten Items
docs.text:
Realized you forgot something while reviewing prices? 1. Click the "➕ Add an Item to this List" box above the tabs. 2. Type in the item name (e.g. "Greek Yogurt" or "Honeycrisp Apples"). 3. Choose the quantity and unit (e.g. 2, lb). 4. Click "Add to List".

The app immediately refreshes with the updated totals and savings!

docs.title: Step 6: Export Custom Lists to Your Phone
docs.text:
Once you're happy with your shopping plan, switch to the Optimised Cart tab: 1. Review your total spend, your estimated savings, and the items assigned to each store. 2. Click the big green button: "📤 Export Store Lists to AnyList". 3. Open the AnyList app on your iPhone or Android.

You will find new, beautifully organized sub-lists (for example, "Weekly Groceries (ALDI)" and "Weekly Groceries (Trader Joe's)"). When you walk into ALDI, open your ALDI list and check off items as you go!

docs.title: 📝 Tips for Writing Items in AnyList
docs.text: Grocery Helper includes a smart matching engine that automatically detects item sizes, units, and spelling. Follow these simple tips when adding items to your grocery list for the most accurate prices:

docs.title: Include Quantities and Units
docs.text: If you know how much you need, include the quantity right in the item title: - "Honeycrisp Apples 3 lbs" - "Whole Milk 1 gal" - "Diet Coke 12pk" - "Eggs 1 dozen" (or "Eggs 12ct")

docs.title: Specify Varieties or Organic
docs.text: If you prefer organic or specific varieties, mention it: - "Organic Bananas" vs. "Bananas" - "Sourdough Bread" vs. "Bread" - "Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast" vs. "Chicken"

docs.title: Don't Worry About Minor Typos
docs.text: The matching engine automatically corrects minor spelling differences (e.g., "avacados", "spinich" or abbreviations like "Coffee w/ milk").

docs.title: Do I need a paid AnyList subscription?
docs.text: No. Grocery Helper works with both free AnyList accounts and AnyList Complete (paid) accounts.

docs.title: What if I don't have an AnyList account?
docs.text: You can still use Grocery Helper completely free in Demo Mode! It will give you realistic price comparisons, route optimizations, and savings estimates using built-in grocery lists.

docs.title: How does Grocery Helper know grocery prices?
docs.text:
• Live Weekly Sale Circulars: Grocery Helper can fetch live weekly advertised deals directly from Market Basket, Whole Foods Market (including Amazon Prime sale prices), and nearby grocery chains for your ZIP code via Flipp (note that circulars publish advertised sale items rather than full everyday catalogs).
  • Live Store APIs: For Kroger family stores (Ralphs, Dillons, King Soopers, Fred Meyer) when configured, Grocery Helper connects to Kroger's product catalog API.
  • Regional Price Models: For baseline everyday pricing and chains without public APIs (like Trader Joe's), Grocery Helper uses calibrated regional grocery price benchmarks.

docs.title: What if a store doesn't carry an item on my list?
docs.text: If an item isn't available at a specific store, Grocery Helper flags it and automatically assigns that item to another store on your route that does carry it.

docs.title: Can I run this without an internet connection?
docs.text: Yes! In Demo Mode, Grocery Helper works 100% offline without needing an active internet connection.
